Title: Azure App Service (Linux) support for Python is now available

Body.Content:
App Service on Linux now offers built-in support for Python 2.6, 3.6, and 3.7 versions. The new language support also comes with a simplified deployment and management experience. This includes integration with Github, BitBucket, and your local git repos.

Learn more
